title: Madness in the Med
summary: Why did Suezmax tankers do so poorly in the Mediterranean? Historically, Suezmax tankers have had a strong presence in Mediterranean crude oil exports. The "Med" has traditionally been a reliable source of employment for the medium sized crude carriers.
